module_summary: 64-bit Ethernet FCS inserter: a 4-state FSM passes AXI-stream payload while a CRC-32 register updated by parallel LFSR instances accumulates, then appends the inverted CRC at frame end, spilling into an extra cycle via a skid-buffered output.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/PAYLOAD/PAD/FCS controller for passing payload, padding and appending FCS

anchors.name: crc_state
anchors.why: Running CRC-32 register fed to all LFSR instances, reset per frame

anchors.name: update_crc
anchors.why: Enables loading crc_state with crc_next7 on accepted beats

anchors.name: crc_next7
anchors.why: Full 64-bit LFSR next CRC; representative of per-byte-count crc_next outputs

anchors.name: fcs_s_tdata
anchors.why: Data presented to CRC LFSRs (masked payload or padding zeros)

anchors.name: fcs_s_tkeep
anchors.why: Byte-valid pattern selecting which crc_next and FCS placement is used

anchors.name: fcs_m_tdata_0
anchors.why: Final beat with inverted CRC inserted after the last payload bytes

anchors.name: fcs_m_tdata_1
anchors.why: Spill-over FCS bytes for an extra output cycle

anchors.name: last_cycle_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Holds spill-over FCS bytes emitted in STATE_FCS

anchors.name: last_cycle_tkeep_reg
anchors.why: Keep mask for the spill-over FCS cycle

anchors.name: frame_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Frame byte counter used for minimum-length padding (ENABLE_PADDING)

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata_masked
anchors.why: Input data with invalid bytes zeroed by tkeep

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input frame payload data

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input valid; accepted beats update CRC and advance FSM

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready from s_axis_tready_reg, deasserted in PAD/FCS

anchors.name: s_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of frame triggers FCS insertion path

anchors.name: s_axis_tuser
anchors.why: Error flag; bad frames pass without FCS and with tuser set

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output frame data including appended FCS

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output valid from skid-buffer output register

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready driving skid buffer and early ready

anchors.name: m_axis_tlast
anchors.why: Output end-of-frame marker on last FCS beat

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Level busy indication while FSM not idle

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready gating PAD/FCS progress and skid-buffer storage

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Output data register loaded from int or temp path

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid-buffer temp register holding a beat when output stalls

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable for output registers from internal datapath

groups.name: FCS insert FSM
groups.description: Sequences payload pass-through, padding and FCS append cycles

groups.name: CRC-32 engine
groups.description: Parallel LFSR instances computing CRC over 1-8 bytes into crc_state

groups.name: FCS placement
groups.description: Inserts inverted CRC after last bytes, spilling to an extra beat

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Two-register skid buffer driving the output AXI stream
